towncenter.name: Town Center
towncenter.desc: Heart of the kingdom. Trains villagers, accepts resources, and researches the next Age.

farm.name: Farm
farm.desc: +16 supply. Golden wheat, tended by nobody in particular.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Trains Swordsmen — and Knights once you reach Age II.

archery.name: Archery Range
archery.desc: Trains Archers — and Catapults once you reach Age II.

storage.name: Storehouse
storage.desc: Resource drop-off point. Build near forests and gold to shorten trips.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.desc: Fires arrows at enemies in range. Anchors your defense.

temple.name: Temple
temple.desc: Required to advance to Age II. Trains Priests and Sorcerers in Age II.

wall.name: Wall
wall.desc: A sturdy stone barrier to protect your kingdom.
